name: Exceptions
problem: How can a program handle the concrete design pressure represented by exceptions without making the surrounding reasoning unsafe or needlessly expensive?

origin.summary: The mechanism is documented; first inventor, year and priority are not asserted here.

mechanism: Exceptions is one family of answers to reporting and recovering from failed operations. The implementation determines what is checked, when it is checked, and which representation crosses the boundary.
solutionFamily: reporting and recovering from failed operations
costs: The chosen enforcement point moves cost between runtime, compiler, author and operator.
A guarantee applies only within its documented boundary and escape hatches.
transferRule: When another language presents exceptions, first identify its enforcement boundary and then compare the same failure case.
